name: Soil-Structure Interaction
description: Soil structure interaction (SSI), significance and their types: shallow/deep foundation, retaining/buried structures interactions. Factors influencing SSI: soil, structure, Embedment, loading, and boundary conditions. Conventional versus SSI-based design. Elastic versus elastic-plastic soil behaviour. Winkler/ Pasternak/ Filonenko-Borodich foundation model. Effect of SSI on: bearing capacity, settlement, foundation, and structure response. Structural dynamics fundamentals, wave propagation in soils, dynamic soil properties. Dynamic SSI modeling approaches, impedance functions, time-domain analysis, earthquake loading, machine-induced vibrations. Radiation damping in soil, kinematic interaction concepts. Numerical modeling of SSI, boundary element techniques, coupled soil-structure analysis. Modeling SSI effects on high-rise buildings, bridges, seismic base isolation, pile-soil interaction, and real-world case studies.
